nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.eicab_masks.resolve_eicab_mask(eicab_dir: pathlib.Path, preference: EicabMaskKind = 'cw', *, prefer_postprocessed: bool = True) → EicabMaskResolution¶

Return the eICAB label NIfTI path for preference, with warn-and-fallback.

When prefer_postprocessed is True and a *_pp sibling of the base mask exists, that post-processed file is returned (postprocessed=True).
